advancement_rule: at most TWO nonlinear candidates; priority race-macro primary > temporal/threshold consistency > bootstrap > Brier/ECE > coherence > stages > complementarity; null result valid
compute_budget: challenger fits ~216 binary; HGB fast; XGB 300-tree hist CPU; stop before expanding on overrun
diversity_policy: diagnostics only (correlation, race-delta overlap, disagreement); no blending/stacking/weights, ever in D
firewall_2025: NONE (dev seasons only + tripwire + ProtectedHoldoutError + scans + tests)

fit_budget.note: 4cfg x 4thr x (6 inner + 3 outer); within ~100/family spirit (108); no expansion permitted

hgb_grid_prior: mission neighborhood around V3.3 tree experience; 4 explicit configs (no cartesian bloat)

inner_temporal_selection.mechanism: frozen M6 expanding-window inner splits (inner_splits.resolve_inner_splits), outer TRAIN history only
inner_temporal_selection.score: mean over inner folds of [mean over 4 thresholds of race-macro LL], per outer fold
inner_temporal_selection.shared_config: ONE family configuration shared across all four thresholds (no per-threshold selection)

outer_evaluation: select on TRAIN history only; refit 4 models on full outer TRAIN; predict outer VALIDATION once; RAW+PAVA; metrics
stage_partition: frozen EARLY/MID/LATE via stages.stage_partition on race_progress_frac; descriptive only
structure: four independent binary models per config, one per threshold; frozen order [top1,top3,top5,top10]; PAVA per state after
threshold_aggregation: unweighted mean; per-threshold LLs persisted; 4x3 direction matrix
tie_break: lowest inner score wins; ties within 1e-6 broken by preregistered simplicity order (HGB: lower lr, fewer leaves, higher min_leaf; XGB: lower lr, higher min_child); never outer validation
xgb_grid_prior: V3.3D refined winner (lr 0.03, depth 3, min_child 5) neighborhood; no V3.5 validation evidence used
